Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of the resulting Ni and NiZn alloy catalysts show characteristic reflections of Ni(111) and Ni(200) for Ni3Zn1-MMO and Ni1Zn1-MMO, and reflections of (231) and (522) for Ni1Zn3-MMO, indicating the formation of NiZn alloy with different phases. HRTEM images confirm the lattice spacing corresponding to these planes.
